title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘to use the cash balances associated with Russian sovereign assets immobilised under EU sanctions’
part_context: Reiterates its firm conviction that Russia must pay for the massive damage caused in Ukraine, and calls once more for the EU <del>to use the cash balances associated with Russian sovereign assets immobilised under EU sanctions</del> to back a reparations loan that would serve to support Ukraine’s defence and reconstruction and increase pressure on Russia to end its war of aggression; strongly supports the Council’s conclusion that the co-legislators should continue working on the Commission’s reparation loan proposal;
